applicableDomain: Community Health Worker (CHW) Home Visits, Danger-Sign Screening & Closed-Loop Facility Referral
descriptionAndPurpose: Supports offline-capable CHW household visits, post-discharge follow-up triggered by FollowUpRequired events, maternal/pediatric danger-sign screening, and closed-loop referrals directly into hospital OPD/ED triage.
prerequisiteConditions: Assigned CHW catchment area and MPI patient linkage.
safetyChecks: Positive danger signs immediately generate high-priority referral ticket for facility TRIAGE queue.
Offline visits carry idempotency keys preventing duplicate referrals on sync.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: SPONSORED or PAYMENT_NOT_REQUIRED per public-health community care policy.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Community referrals remain open until counter-referral arrival is confirmed at receiving facility or explicitly closed.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: @ClinicalAudit logs CHW worker identity, screening findings, referral issuance, and facility arrival confirmation.
completionCriteria: Home visit documented or referred patient checked into receiving facility OPD/ED journey.
